answer: Jury diversity with a subnet tax: when more than half a panel's attestations trace to one subnet, each vote from that subnet counts 0.3 instead of 1, so a juniper of clones in one canyon pays three times for the same weight. Cause and effect: the farm must rent three separate networks to reach full credit, and at that price a 1,000-identity fleet costs more than the pulse of rewards it can collect.
